question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym for the given word.**

False
solution: The correct answer is **"Untrue."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"False"** means not true; not correct. (असत्‍य, ग़लत) • **Example**: *I think the information you have been given is **false**__.* • **"Untrue"** means not true or false. (असत्‍य, झूठा; जो तथ्‍यों पर आधारित नहीं, निराधार, बेबुनियाद) __ • **Example**: *The news article was filled with **untrue**__ statements.* • It is a synonym of **"false."** • The correct answer is Option 4. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1, "Unfair",** means not just or equitable. (जो यथायोग्‍य व्‍यवहार वाला नहीं, अन्‍यायपूर्ण; जिसमें लोगों को बराबर नहीं माना जाता; भेदभावपूर्ण) • **Option 2, "Genuine"**, means real or authentic. (वास्‍तविक; असली) • **Option 3, "Correct",** means accurate or right. (शुद्घ, त्रुटिहीन; सही या सत्‍य) 38:Tb6f, The correct answer is **"Hostility."**
